name: infrabase
description: Search a hand-verified directory of AI infrastructure products, find alternatives by job, and compare verified per-model LLM prices and European providers.

interface.longDescription:
Infrabase is a hand-verified directory of AI infrastructure: inference APIs, GPU clouds, vector databases, agent frameworks, observability, gateways and more. Every listing is checked against the vendor's own pages.

Use it to:
- search products by what they do (for example vector databases, LLM gateways, speech-to-text)
- find alternatives to a product, ranked by how closely they do the same job
- compare verified per-token prices for a model across hosting providers, each row linked to the provider's pricing page and dated
- list European-headquartered providers, for data residency questions

No account or sign-in. Every result carries a link to its Infrabase page and, for prices, the source page and the date it was checked. The data is CC-BY-4.0.
defaultPrompt: Which European providers host gpt-oss-120b, and what do they charge?
What are the alternatives to Pinecone?
List vector databases from companies based in Europe

positive.prompt: What are some alternatives to fal.ai for running image and video models?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns providers that do the same job, such as Replicate and Modal, same-job products first, each with a link to its Infrabase page.

positive.description: Compare prices for one model across European providers
positive.prompt: Which European providers serve gpt-oss-120b and what do they charge?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists European-headquartered providers ranked cheapest first, such as Melious AI, Scaleway and IONOS, with input and output prices per 1M tokens in the provider's currency, the source pricing page and the date each price was verified.

positive.prompt: List vector databases from companies headquartered in Europe.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists European vector databases such as Qdrant (Germany), Weaviate (Netherlands) and Vespa (Norway), each with its country and Infrabase link.

positive.prompt: Look up Replicate on Infrabase: what it does, its pricing model, where it is based and when it was founded.
positive.expected_behavior: Describes Replicate with its pricing model (usage-based), headquarters country (US), founding year (2019) and a link to its Infrabase page.

positive.prompt: Which LLMs can I compare prices for on Infrabase, and which provider is cheapest for each?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the models with verified prices, the number of providers for each and the cheapest provider with its input and output price per 1M tokens, linked to the Infrabase model pages.

negative.description: Out of scope: travel booking. Infrabase only covers AI infrastructure products, so no tool should be called.
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel in Stockholm for next weekend.

negative.description: Unsupported write: every tool is read-only, so the request cannot be completed and ChatGPT should say so.
Unsupported forecast: the plugin only has current verified prices, so it should give those with their dates and not invent future prices.
negative.prompt: What will Groq charge for Llama next year?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. All six tools are read-only.

publication.release_notes: First release. Six read-only tools over the Infrabase.ai directory: product search by job, category and region; product details; alternatives ranked by job match; verified per-model prices across providers; the list of priced models; and European providers. No authentication. Data is CC-BY-4.0.
